exercise.neckTilt.title: Neck side stretch
exercise.neckTilt.text: Slowly lower your right ear toward your right shoulder. Keep your shoulders down.
exercise.neckTilt.second: Now the left side. Slow and gentle.
exercise.chinTuck.title: Chin tuck
exercise.chinTuck.text: Head level, gently pull your chin straight back, like making a double chin. Hold 3 seconds, release, repeat.
exercise.shoulderRoll.title: Shoulder rolls
exercise.shoulderRoll.text: Lift your shoulders toward your ears, then roll them back and down. Slow, big circles.
exercise.scapula.title: Shoulder blade squeeze
exercise.scapula.text: Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Hold 3 seconds, release.
exercise.twist.title: Seated twist
exercise.twist.text: Sit tall and slowly turn your upper body to the right. Use the chair for support.
exercise.twist.second: Now turn to the left. Keep breathing.
exercise.reachUp.title: Reach up
exercise.reachUp.text: Raise your arms overhead and reach for the ceiling. Breathe in deeply, then slowly out.
exercise.chestOpen.title: Chest opener
exercise.chestOpen.text: Clasp your hands behind your head, open your elbows wide and gently lift your chest.

porcini.tagline: A calm forest friend who never rushes

porcini.greeting.1.other: Ahh, hello. %1 minutes of stillness. Even mushrooms reach for the light. Shall we?

porcini.greeting.2: The forest is quiet. A perfect moment to unfold your spine, slowly.
porcini.greeting.3: Slow down, little sprout. A minute of stretching keeps the roots happy.

porcini.eager.2: An early stretch. The moss approves. Let us begin.

porcini.cheer.3: Your back thanks you, and so do I. Grow well.
